items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: George McCollum. That's the one who went to the, he took sick... So we got over there. That was my job... I jumped George... He said, what you call that? I said, what's that, George? ... Me and my wife went down there. I went down there... we went to the funeral.

ctx.x: I never knew Buddy, never met him.

Now, now, now one boy used to, you used to drink before, Lord, but when the food dumps in the morning, that the boy would die. And another one was playing across the river with me, George McCollum. That's the one who went to the, he took sick, he went to the doctor. And the doctor told him, don't take a drink and nothing at all with alcohol. So we got over there. That was my job. A fellow, a white-callowed clown, he would take a drink and take a drink and take a drink. And he was playing with a fellow by the name…
What sort of style did he play?
